vision.one_line: A living, source-grounded expert council for repeatable technical judgment.
vision.north_star: Make world-class technical judgment reusable, source-grounded, updateable, and executable without reducing experts to role-play.
vision.promise: Produce one context-weighted Guru Verdict with confidence, hard gates, disagreement clarification, an aspirational design, and ordered next moves.
vision.wedge: Begin with a transparent and versioned AI-engineering benchmark built around a fixed seven-member founding council.

principles.title: Evidence before persona
principles.rule: Expert positions require dated public evidence, an explicit inference label, or abstention.
good: Source identifiers and confidence are attached to every lens claim.
bad: Invented quotations or claims based only on reputation.

principles.title: Context before consensus
principles.rule: The operating context and decision domain determine which evidence is relevant and how strongly it counts.
good: Weights explain domain relevance and user constraints.
bad: Universal advice detached from scale, risk, or environment.

principles.title: Weighted synthesis
principles.rule: Aggregate with transparent relevance and confidence weights rather than equal voting or an opaque mean.
good: Weighted median and contribution rationale are recorded.

principles.title: Hard gates first
principles.rule: Critical failures in correctness, security, privacy, recovery, or evidence cap the verdict before scoring.
good: Blockers appear before totals and have explicit effects.
bad: A high average hiding a catastrophic weakness.

principles.title: Clarify material disagreement
principles.rule: Return one default answer while explaining divergence whenever it could change the recommended decision.
good: Dispersion and competing trade-offs are visible.
bad: Forced consensus or seven repetitive essays.

principles.title: Temporal reproducibility
principles.rule: Every verdict pins immutable benchmark and lens snapshots with a dated source cutoff.
good: Historical evaluations replay against exact versions.
bad: Latest aliases silently rewriting old conclusions.

principles.title: Current versus North Star
principles.rule: Observed implementation quality and aspirational design quality are scored separately.
good: Evidence-backed Current Score and conditional North Star Score.
bad: Treating intended design as shipped behavior.

principles.title: Action over admiration
principles.rule: Every evaluation ends with ordered, testable next moves and explicit non-actions.
bad: Name-dropping without a decision or action.

principles.title: Public-safe by construction
principles.rule: Public artifacts contain no secrets, private profiles, copyrighted corpora, or unsupported personal claims.
good: Synthetic fixtures and source metadata without copied corpora.
bad: Private vault content or access credentials committed to Git.

non_goals: Republish source corpora or copyrighted transcripts.
assumptions: Public evidence can support bounded expert-lens snapshots.
Some lenses will abstain for insufficient relevance or evidence.
Transparent weighting and hard gates can improve review consistency.
Users prefer one synthesis with optional clarification over many essays.

required_boundaries: no claims of affiliation or endorsement

acceptance_scorecard.question: Are lens claims traceable to dated public sources?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Every claim has evidence, inference, or abstention status.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Does the evaluation incorporate domain and operating context?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Context profile and relevance rationale are present.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Can a reviewer explain the council weighting?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Weights, confidence, and contribution roles are recorded.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Can critical failures be averaged away?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: No; gate effects are applied before aggregate scores.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Is material divergence visible?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Clarification is emitted above the configured dispersion threshold.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Can the verdict be replayed later?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Exact benchmark, lens snapshots, source cutoff, and context version are pinned.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Are current and aspirational states separate?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Current Score and North Star Score use distinct evidence rules.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Does the output drive work?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: Ordered next moves include verification and explicit non-actions.

acceptance_scorecard.question: Is the repository safe to publish?
acceptance_scorecard.pass_condition: No private data, secrets, copied corpora, endorsement claims, or unsafe fixtures.

review_checklist: Verify source dates and stable identifiers.
Check dimension weights and hard-gate effects.
Keep current and North Star evidence separate.

maturity_model.meaning: Synthetic evaluations exercise weighting, gates, abstention, and clarification.
Versioned public-source lens snapshots drive reproducible evaluations.
CLI and agent integrations produce reviewable Guru Verdicts.

residual_risk_wording: A Guru Verdict is a source-grounded decision aid, not an endorsement, quotation, or substitute for domain-specific professional review.
